title: StateHash silently hashes zero bytes when serialized state exceeds its fixed 4096-byte buffer, making replay-equality fail open
detail: SerializeState returns 0 when the state exceeds 4096 bytes; StateHash then calls Fnv1a64 with Size==0, which returns the constant FNV64_OFFSET (verified in PP_Hash.h). Any run whose topology/packets/action log crosses 4 KiB hashes identically, so the ODN-11 replay/tamper-equality check silently becomes vacuous.
recommended_fix: Fail loudly instead: have StateHash detect N==0 (or query the needed size / serialize into a growable buffer) and abort or latch an error rather than returning the hash of zero bytes.

title: StepScenario silently truncates action-log commands at 16 per tick — dropped commands set no error latch
detail: ApplyEdit logs every live edit with apply_tick = Tick+1, so 17 edits between two steps share one tick; StepScenario's N<16 guard silently drops the 17th — replay under-applies the log with no ReplayError latch, violating the never-silent divergence contract.
recommended_fix: Grow the per-tick buffer dynamically (std::vector) or count matches first and abort/latch ReplayError when the fixed capacity would truncate the log.
